sources_note: Every record below was re-fetched live from the museum API on 2026-11-08 (Met collectionapi v1 objects, AIC api.artic.edu, Cleveland openaccess-api). title_ja is inferred unless title_ja_source="museum". The Met v1 /search endpoint was retired on 2026-10-01; v1.1/search was used.

eras.notes: Ink-only prints. All picks have AIC/Met medium text saying sumizuri-e or "ink on paper", except 2 flagged. Many AIC Moronobu/Sugimura sheets are erotic-series prints; those were excluded.
